controls.label: 刷新纪念日
controls.inline: async function load(){if(loading)return;loading=true;refresh.disabled=true;entries.replaceChildren();entries.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');entries.append(UI.components.loading({mode:'skeleton',label:'正在打开纪念日…'}));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,400));loading=false;refresh.disabled=false;entries.removeAttribute('aria-busy');if(UI.failNext('anniversary-load')){entries.replaceChildren();entries.append(UI.components.state({kind:'error',title:'纪念日暂时打不开',action:'重试加载纪念日',onAction:load}));}else render();}

events.handler: event=>{event.preventDefault();const name=form.elements.name.value.trim(),date=form.elements.date.value;if(!name||!D.parse(date)){const field=!name?form.elements.name:form.elements.date;UI.fieldError(field,!name?'请填写纪念日名称':'请选择有效日期');field.focus();return;}UI.busy(form.querySelector('.submit'),'保存中…',()=>{if(UI.failNext('anniversary-save'))throw new Error('纪念日未保存成功，请重试');const reminder=form.elements.reminder.value,item={...existing,id:existing?.id||'anniversary-'+crypto.randomUUID(),name,date,repeat:form.elements.repeat.checked,enabled:reminder!=='不提醒',reminderDays:reminder==='当天'?0:reminder==='提前 1 天'?1:3,momentId:select.value||null,createdAt:existing?.createdAt||Date.now(),updatedAt:Date.now()};if(!put(item))return false;UI.toast('纪念日已保存','success');return leave.complete(existing?route(item):list());});}

controls.inline: async()=>{const action=await UI.sheet({title:'纪念日操作',actions:[{label:'删除纪念日',value:'delete',danger:true}]});if(action!=='delete'||!await UI.modal({title:'删除这个纪念日？',message:'相关时刻和日记仍保留。',confirm:'确认删除', danger: true,cancel:'取消'}))return;UI.busy(more,'删除中…',()=>{if(UI.failNext('anniversary-delete'))throw new Error('删除没有完成，请重试');if(!UI.write(KEY,all().filter(v=>v.id!==item.id)))return false;return UI.go(list(),{force:true});});}

controls.inline: async function load(){if(loading)return;loading=true;cards.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');cards.replaceChildren(UI.components.loading({mode:'skeleton',label:'正在打开胶囊架…'}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));loading=false;cards.removeAttribute('aria-busy');if(UI.failNext('capsule-load')){cards.replaceChildren();cards.append(UI.components.state({kind:'error',title:'胶囊架暂时打不开',action:'重试加载胶囊',onAction:load}));}else paint();}

controls.inline: async()=>{const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='date';input.value=form.elements.opening.value;input.min=D.today().iso;input.setAttribute('aria-label','胶囊开启日期');const action=await UI.sheet({title:'开启日期',content:input,actions:[{label:'使用这个日期',value:'apply'}]});if(action==='apply'){if(!D.parse(input.value)){UI.fieldError(form.elements.opening,'请选择有效日期');return;}form.elements.opening.value=input.value;UI.fieldError(form.elements.opening,'');}}
